name: SearChat
description: Conversational AI search engine with multi-model support, several search backends and a deep-research mode.
whatItDoes: Provides multi-turn, chat-style web search with cited answers and an optional deep-research workflow. It is for people who want to self-host a Perplexity-like service.
howItWorks: A Turborepo monorepo pairs a Node.js/Koa backend with a Vue 3 front end. The backend calls search engines such as Bing, Google, SearXNG, Tavily or Exa and passes results to OpenAI-, Anthropic- or Gemini-compatible models. It deploys with Docker Compose or runs from source with yarn.

requirements.name: LLM provider
requirements.description: OpenAI-, Anthropic- or Gemini-compatible model access
